newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fueL flat to weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fueL flat to weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was flat to slightly weaker on Friday in extremely quiet trade with ample supplies seen pressuring premiums next week, traders said.
Jet fuel barges were seen around June IPE gas oil +$18/+$19 a tonne. June IPE gas oil settled $1.75 lower at $172.50 a tonne. Swaps were flat with June paper done at $20.
Traders said the market was looking slightly sloppy and that premiums could come under some pressure next week. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
